channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Sen. Britt discusses federal healthcare policy, criticisms of ICE
item.description: Britt discussed ongoing healthcare negotiations and the Trump administration’s immigration policy during a recent panel.

item.title: Opinion | The division of chocolate
item.description: Those determined to divide the country will use anything at their disposal. Even boxes of chocolate.

item.title: Orange Beach faces lawsuit alleging violation of Open Meetings Act
item.description: Plaintiffs allege the Orange Beach City Council failed to provide mandatory 24-hour notice of a special called meeting.

item.title: This Week on The V: Extremism claims and Alabama’s fight over pluralism
item.description: Tuberville’s rhetoric, legislative culture wars, campus lawsuits, and national cruelty converge in a week testing Alabama’s constitutional values.

item.title: Opinion | When citizens disengage, self-government erodes in Alabama
item.description: Low turnout and habit-driven politics quietly replace accountability, leaving power unchallenged and citizens forgetting their responsibility in a self-governing state.

item.title: Manufacture Alabama announces Senate 2026 election cycle endorsements
item.description: Manufacture Alabama announced endorsements for the 2026 election cycle, recognizing incumbents who championed industry priorities and supported pro-manufacturing policies.

item.title: UAB study finds oral semaglutide effective for weight loss
item.description: Oral semaglutide proved nearly as effective as the injectable version for treating obesity, delivering 13.7 percent average weight loss in a 64-week trial.

item.title: Bill to require post-election audits refiled for 2026 session
item.description: Legislation seeking mandatory countywide and statewide general election audits was prefiled, requiring probate judges to oversee the auditing process.

item.title: Alabama receives portion of multi-state Mercedes-Benz settlement
item.description: Mercedes-Benz will pay $149 million and provide consumer relief after states found the automaker used illegal emissions software in diesel vehicles.

item.title: Jackson Hospital finances, bankruptcy loan, BCBS lawsuit collide
item.description: Records show rising revenue, recurring losses, a powerful DIP lender, and a reimbursement lawsuit shaping Jackson Hospital’s uncertain future ahead.
